import json, subprocess, sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from gen2 import gen_case, make_passing
rng = random.Random(5)
cases=[]
for i in range(4):
    c = gen_case(rng, 5, 3, 2, 1)
    make_passing(c, rng)
    c['model'] = 'cnn' if i % 2 == 0 else 'rnn'
    cases.append(c)
req={'version':3,'cases':cases}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(req).encode(),capture_output=True,env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LD_LIBRARY_PATH':'/workspace/native','PYTHONPATH':'/workspace/vendor'})
print('exit',p.returncode,'err',p.stderr[:200])
r=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
for c,res in zip(cases,r['results']):
    print(c['model'], res['ratio'], res['assignment'], res['predictions'], 'util', res['utility'])
"
